observations: Professional LED headlight with a circular lens and four external diffuser panels.
The unit is mounted on a black tripod stand.
The lens appears to be a standard 100mm diameter.
The brand name 'VIVID' is visible on the side of the lens housing in photo 0.
The seller's text mentions 'LED Red Head Light' and 'reliable continuous light'.

claims.evidence: The photo shows a white lens, but the red color of the LED itself is not visible.

risks.risk: The LED may be non-functional or have a dead battery.
risks.proof: A video showing the light powered on and producing a strong beam.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be depleted or the charging circuit may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the light running on battery power.

risks.risk: The lens may have scratches, fungus, or a cracked glass element.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the lens glass.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the light powered on and shining through the lens.
Close-up photo of the lens glass to check for scratches or fungus.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
